question: Will Slipknot drop Marilyn Manson from their (sic)est Stadium Tour before the end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:

- The window covers the period strictly after 2026-09-30T18:26:30.851Z and at or before 2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; events or announcements outside this window do not count.
